title: Houthis advance as government forces move to defend Aden
detail: Al Jazeera reports Houthi forces are advancing in Yemen while government forces move to defend Aden. Only the headline was available at time of writing; details to be confirmed.

media.caption: Houthis advance in Yemen as government forces move to defend Aden

title: Syria reported ready to send thousands of troops to Yemen as Saudi Arabia builds anti-Houthi coalition
detail: A Google News-aggregated report says Syria could send thousands of troops to Yemen as Saudi Arabia assembles a new coalition against the Houthis. Only the headline was available; the originating outlet and details are unconfirmed.
